access_history_before_freeze.note: Study_30 was used only to verify the published FileList JSON schema; it is assigned to fit, never confirmation.

objective: train a study-robust transmitted-light encoder that predicts author-labelled organelle fluorescence and quantify cross-study generalization, uncertainty, and OOD without Aleph execution

source.title: Light My Cells : Bright Field to Fluorescence Imaging Challenge

author_label_contract.unrecognized_file_policy: retain in metadata audit but exclude from supervised task

split_contract.assignment_algorithm: sort Study_1..Study_30 by sha256(salt + '|' + study_id); first 6 confirmation, next 4 calibration, next 4 selection, remaining 16 fit
split_contract.inaccessible_study_policy: refuse that study before pixels; require at least four accessible confirmation studies and do not backfill

model_contract.input: one registered transmitted-light z-stack or provider-declared best-focus plane
model_contract.output: four target-specific normalized fluorescence maps plus target-presence and predictive-uncertainty heads
model_contract.missing_target_channels: masked loss, never a negative label
training_stages: self-supervised acquisition-set contrastive pretraining on fit inputs
target-specific fluorescence reconstruction on fit studies
architecture and stopping selection on selection studies
exactly one evaluation on single-use confirmation studies
model_may_not_use: study identifier as a predictive feature
file path tokens beyond modality and z index
confirmation images or metrics for fitting, selection, stopping, normalization, or calibration

evaluation_contract.inference_unit: study-level metric aggregate; acquisition sets are nested technical observations
evaluation_contract.supported_target_rule: report a target only when at least 25 confirmation acquisition sets contain it
evaluation_contract.ood_metric: study-level embedding OOD AUROC against fit-study embeddings

authority_contract.success_role: cross-study validated label-free organelle representation and observation prediction
